surface_mechanism_description: B2H6 was used as an additional reducing agent for WF6 to lower the resistivity of the ALD-WNx film. By allowing the B2H6 exposure to take place before the WF6 exposure, an ALD-W layer can be formed and this layer can be successfully converted to an ALD-WNx layer by the final exposure to NH3.
